title: PixelKin - The Undertide (bare gbc)
_note: The Undertide, the sea-caves under the Farlamp Isles (I-IV): shallow channels, tide-races switched by tide-bells, drips. The Farlamp family's deep rung: the hymn FRAGMENTED and LOW - only the rope-pull (D-A) and the three-step haul survive, an octave down, with long rests, and the phrase sinks to the Phrygian Eb instead of settling. Bare 4-voice gbc (deep cave, score bible 3.3): pulse25 low lead; pulse12 = drips (each echoed fainter) and distant tide-bells (soft high D/A, one Phrygian Eb); tri_bass = the held tide, D with an Eb lean every 8 bars; drums = far toms and a hiss of open hat for water. 84 BPM, 3/4, D minor (Phrygian). 32 bars, 68.6 s. Original (VISION.md).
